items.title: XRP Ledger is set to fix its lending code before anyone can use it
items.summary: Validators have a bug-fix patch on course to go live Friday.

items.title: World launches World ID suite for banks, makes Zoom deepfake check generally available
items.summary: World ID for Zoom is generally available after a beta that began in April, and is designed to spot deepfaked participants on Zoom calls.

items.title: Qubic freezes chain after attacker drains 1.4K wallets with weak seeds
items.summary: Qubic says 87.1% of the stolen funds remain onchain and the rest were frozen at crypto exchange MEXC, as network validators prepare to vote on a recovery plan.

items.title: MapQuest Now Shows Drivers Where Flock Cameras Are Watching
items.summary: MapQuest’s app now offers an optional map layer that plots known license plate readers from Flock Safety and other vendors, as backlash against the cameras grows.
